standard_prerequisites.name: The key statement relating absolute flatness of A and B to flatness of B tensor_A B -> B
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives part (1) outright and is applied to A' -> B' in part (2).

standard_prerequisites.name: A reduced ring embeds into the product of its residue fields at minimal primes, and a product of fields is absolutely flat
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the absolutely flat ring A' receiving A.

standard_prerequisites.name: Base change of a weakly etale ring map, and the statement that an absolutely flat ring is reduced
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows A' -> B' is weakly etale and hence B' is reduced.

core_obligations: Conclude part (1) immediately from the key lemma and the definitions (proof line 30332).

For part (2), assume A is reduced and use the Algebra statement on reduced rings and the statement that a product of fields is absolutely flat to obtain an injection A -> A' = product over minimal primes p of A of A_p with A' absolutely flat (proof lines 30333-30337).
Use flatness of A -> B to conclude that the induced map B -> B' = B tensor_A A' is injective (proof lines 30338-30339).
Use the base change statement for weakly etale maps to conclude that A' -> B' is weakly etale (proof lines 30339-30340).
Apply part (1) to see B' is absolutely flat, and the absolutely flat statement to see B' is reduced; since B injects into B', conclude B is reduced (proof lines 30341-30343).
difficulty_reason: Let A -> B be a ring map such that B tensor_A B -> B is flat. The lemma asserts two things: if A is absolutely flat then so is B; and if A is reduced and A -> B is weakly etale then B is reduced (source lines 30322-30329). Part (1) the author disposes of in one line, as an immediate consequence of the key lemma and the definitions (proof line 30332). For part (2), the proof assumes A reduced and produces an injection A -> A' = product over the minimal primes of A of A_p into an absolutely flat ring, quoting the Algebra statement that a reduced ring embeds into the product of its residue fields at minimal primes together with the lemma that a product of fields is absolutely flat (proof lines 30333-30337). If A -> B is flat then the induced map B -> B' = B tensor_A A' is injective too (proof lines 30338-30339). By the base change statement the map A' -> B' is weakly etale (proof lines 30339-30340). Part (1) then shows B' is absolutely flat, and the absolutely flat statement shows B' is reduced (proof lines 30341-30342). Since B injects into the reduced ring B', B is reduced, completing the proof (proof lines 30342-30343). The non-routine content is the reduction of reducedness of B to that of the base changed ring B', which is legitimate only because the base change stays injective, a fact that uses flatness of A -> B.
